name: pi-agent-server
description: A long-running Pi Agent service built with Fastify and the Pi SDK.

scripts.test:cutover: pnpm test:age && cross-env PI_RUN_REAL_AGE_CUTOVER=1 vitest run tests/cutover/cutover-real-age.test.ts
scripts.build:migrate: tsc -p tsconfig.migrate.json && node scripts/smoke-migrate-compiled.mjs && node scripts/smoke-migrate-package.mjs
scripts.build:backup: tsc -p tsconfig.backup.json && node scripts/smoke-backup-compiled.mjs && node scripts/smoke-backup-package.mjs
scripts.build:cutover: tsc -p tsconfig.cutover.json && node scripts/smoke-cutover-compiled.mjs && node scripts/smoke-cutover-package.mjs
scripts.test:restore-real: pnpm test:age && cross-env PI_RUN_REAL_AGE_RESTORE=1 vitest run tests/backup/restore-core.test.ts
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build:backup
scripts.verify:release: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run test:postgres && npm run test:pg-backup && npm run test:migration-prebackup && npm run test:cutover && npm run test:cutover-pg && npm run test:restore-real && npm run build && npm run build:migrate && npm run build:backup && npm run build:cutover
scripts.release:rc: npm run verify:release && npm publish --tag rc
